_comment: GTP deployment variants for the RRMS demo. Each variant is a copy of the
canonical app (cxas_app/rrms-v1) with DEFAULT_CALLER_PHONE substituted in
the before_agent callback, its app identity set, and appConfigOverrides
deep-merged into app.json. Managed by deploy-variants.sh — never edit the
variant apps directly. app_id is filled in automatically on first deploy.
appConfigOverrides (below) preserves Console-only advanced settings that a
plain push would otherwise reset (Cloud Logging, BigQuery export, live
audio-recording bucket). The repo is the source of truth: edit values here.
A per-variant appConfigOverrides may be added inside a variant to override
the shared block for that one app.

variants.name: rrms-demo-store
variants.description: UC1 — Johnson Verizon Store (single-site, passcode Sunset)

variants.name: rrms-demo-multisite
variants.description: UC2 — multi-location manager: Dallas/Fort Worth/Plano (passcode Bluebird)
